'''Fell Dargun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He had a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] gladiator by the name of [[Borga (Gamorrean)|Borga]] in his servitude.

==Biography==
Fell Dargun was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was in the gladiator business. At some point, he acquired a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] by the name of [[Borga (Gamorrean)|Borga]], and had him fight under his name. In [[3643 BBY]], Borga fought a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] at the [[Lady of Pain]]'s [[Lady of Pain's compound|compound]], but was defeated. Dargun expressed his grief, and promised the Lady that he would return with a new, victorious gladiator.<ref name="TOR:ABwtLoP" />
